title: Final Answer for Hydrogen
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state that the linear Stark effect in hydrogen is due to degeneracy with respect to l.

title: Final Answer for Sodium
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state that the quadratic Stark effect in sodium is due to non-degeneracy and the vanishing of the first order energy correction.

title: Explanation of Parity
description: Important Criteria: The response should explain the role of parity in determining the Stark effect for both hydrogen and sodium.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The response must mention the use of perturbation theory in analyzing the Stark effect for both atoms.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid errors related to incorrectly stating the effects of electric field strength on the Stark effect.
